title: Agent Bain vs. Agent McKinsey: A New Text-to-SQL Benchmark for the Business Domain
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measures the performance of large language models on text-to-SQL tasks within the business domain, categorized into descriptive, explanatory, predictive, and recommendational queries.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
